snippet.title: Augment Anthem | Official Trailer | 2D Sci-Fi Metroidvania
snippet.description:
Augment Anthem, a 2D sci-fi metroidvania by Project Ego. Launching May 2026.

Life on Earth is gone. Two superintelligences destroyed the surface world. You are the Anthem's final creation, a synthetic warrior built to reclaim what was lost.

Explore Bunker 7. Fight biomechanical enemies. Combine 4 AI entities: Ascend, Replicate, Magnet, and Amplify, to reshape how you fight, move, and explore. Rebuild Haven for the survivors who refused to give up.

🎮 WISHLIST ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035960/Augment_Anthem/

🌐 LINKS
Website: https://augmentanthem.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/J9Bprp7x4j
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/augmentanthem.com
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@augmentanthem

🎮 FEATURES
 • Augment System — 4 AI entities, each with its own personality, modify your gun, movement, tether, beacon, and drone
 • Interconnected world — abandoned metro tunnels, war-torn ruins, flooded depths, corrupted machine nests
 • Ability-driven exploration — Teleport with Tether, warp with Beacon, unlock new paths as abilities grow
 • Rebuild Haven — upgrade the last survivor settlement with salvaged machine parts
 • Deep lore — uncover the truth behind Id, Superego, and the Anthem

🏷️  TAGS
#AugmentAnthem #metroidvania #indiegame #gamedev #scifi #2Dgame #indiedev #pixelart #steam #projectego 

Developed by Project Ego
